cards.text: Jesus has just finished teaching about forgiveness. Now He leaves Galilee and goes into the region of Judea beyond the Jordan. Large crowds follow Him, and friend, I can't get ONE baker to follow me to the oven without bribing them with sprinkles.

cards.question: Large crowds follow Jesus into Judea beyond the Jordan, and He ___ them there.

cards.text: Then some Pharisees show up, religious leaders who were strict about keeping the Law. The text says they came to test Jesus, so this isn't a question, friend. It's a trap with a question mark on it.

cards.question: The Pharisees come to test Jesus with a question. What do they ask Him about?

answers.text: Divorcing a wife for any reason

cards.question: Jesus answers the Pharisees with a question of His own: 'Have you not read…' Then He points them back to which moment?

answers.text: When the Creator made them male and female
When David became king of Israel

cards.text: They bring a fine print question, and Jesus goes straight to page one. The Creator 'made them male and female,' and said a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, 'and the two will become one flesh.'

cards.question: Jesus says a husband and wife are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what ___ has joined together, let man not ___.

cards.text: Oh, the Pharisees had a comeback LOADED. Why then, they ask, did Moses, Israel's leader, order a man to give his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away?

cards.question: Jesus answers that Moses permitted divorce. What reason does Jesus give for why Moses permitted it?

answers.text: Because of their hardness of heart
Because of their time in Egypt

cards.question: Jesus tells the Pharisees that divorce was the way it was from the beginning.

cards.text: Then Jesus lays it out plainly: 'Now I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another woman commits adultery.'

cards.question: When the disciples hear Jesus's teaching on marriage, they tell Him it is better not to marry.

cards.text: HA! The disciples hear the teaching and their first move is, 'Okay, I'll just stay single.' Jesus tells them not everyone can accept this word, but only those to whom it has been given.
Then Jesus talks about eunuchs. Some were born that way, and others were made that way by men.

cards.question: Jesus says there are still others who live like eunuchs. For the sake of what?

cards.text: Jesus wraps it up: 'The one who can accept this should accept it.' Then little children are brought to Jesus, so He'll place His hands on them and pray for them.

cards.question: Little children are brought to Jesus so He'll pray for them, and the disciples ___ the people who brought them.

cards.text: And Jesus is NOT having it. 'Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them!'

cards.question: Jesus says to let the little children come to Him. Who does He say the kingdom of heaven belongs to?

answers.text: Those who study with the Pharisees

cards.question: Jesus places His hands on the little children before He goes on from there.
